title: NEW FEATURE! PRESTIGE TIERS
body:

Greetings Dragon Masters!

Today we have a new Feature coming to DC that will enhance the way you play and reward your commitment with the game!

## HOW IT WORKS: THE LOYALTY CYCLE 👑

This isn't just a one-time unlock; it’s a dynamic system that reflects your recent activity.

- Earn VIP Points: You gain points through purchases (In-game or Webstore) and specific event rewards.
- 21-Day Cycles: The system runs in 3-week "cycles."

**Promote:** Reach a point milestone mid-cycle to level up instantly.

**Shield your status:** Hit your tier's "checkpoint" to keep your status for the next cycle.

**Challenge reset:** If the checkpoint isn't met by the end of the 21 days, you'll drop one tier.

## THE PERKS: Powering Up Your Gameplay

Higher tiers unlock massive multipliers that make your daily grind much more rewarding:

**🚀 Multipliers:** Huge boosts to XP, Pet Food production, and Arena Leaderboard points.

**💎 Gems & Alliances:** High-tier players can get up to 5x Gems from Jewelem’s Tower and massive contribution boosts to Alliance Chests.

**🤝 Deus Trade:** A legendary perk for top tiers, perform one automatic trade per day without needing any partner to accept it!

**✨ Vanity:** Exclusive Bronze, Silver, and Gold Avatar Frames to show off your rank. (_Coming soon_)

title: YOUR PET IN DRAGON CITY CONTEST
body:
![Your Pet in Dragon City](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/1ckdB0f6enpFtWl7WBqjME/b157020c2ac7428bca8633f0e26d7b97/1520846785_DC_ASO_FeatureGraphic_2411DragonsLogoAOS_Main.jpg)

They sit on your keyboards. They judge your gameplay. They demand cuddles and snacks…

Yes, we’re talking about pets! 🐾

We’re celebrating our adorable companions with a special Community Contest. And who knows… your pet might even have a chance to be **featured in Dragon City**!

How, you might be wondering?

Read on for the rules to participate in our ✨**Your Pet in Dragon City Contest**!✨

---

### **PARTICIPATION RULES**

To participate in our Contest, take a **clear, high-quality photo** of **your real-life pet**.

The Submission must only contain the pet. Submissions containing the image or likeness of any human will be disqualified.

Eligible pets include dogs, cats, birds, small mammals (hamsters, rabbits, guinea pigs, ferrets, etc.), fish, and reptiles.

You have **until April 7th, 2026 at 11:59:00 PM CEST** to share your submission with us.

### **SUBMISSION RULES**

1. Send the submission to [**community.competition@socialpoint.es**](community.competition@socialpoint.es) with the subject line “**Pet Contest Entry – [Your Pet's Name]**”
2. Your Submission must include:

- Your pet’s photo (in the form of a JPG, JPEG, or PNG)
- Your pet’s name
- A one-sentence description of your pet’s personality

### **JUDGING CRITERIA**

We’ll choose our Winners based on

- Creativity and originality;
- Effectiveness in communicating your pet’s unique personality traits;
- Suitability for in-game adaptation.

### **WINNERS**

We’ll select a total of 3 (three) winners.

Each Winner will:

- Have their Submission of their pet adapted into an in-Game pet and released in a future Game update;
- Upon release in-Game, each Winner will receive their pet unlocked for free in their Game account.

The Winners will be notified on or about April 24, 2026 via the email address used when submitting their Submission.

🚨 Before taking part in the Contest, read carefully our T&Cs ➡️[**here**](https://rebrand.ly/DC/PetContestTCs)!

---

**NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. OPEN TO LEGAL RESIDENTS OF THE ELIGIBLE COUNTRIES WHO ARE AT LEAST 18 YEARS OF AGE. THE CONTEST BEGINS AT 12:00 PM CET ON 23/03/2026 AND ENDS AT 11:59 PM CEST ON 07/04/2026. You have **until November 3rd, 2025 at 12:00:00 PM CET** to share your submission with us.

We’ll choose our Winners based on the originality and creativity of the submission, how well the “Halloween theme” is incorporated into your drawing, as well as technical art skill.

Coral reefs are some of the most important ecosystems in the world. They provide habitat and food to many fish species and reduce coastal erosion, reducing the damage of floods and big storms. Thus, they play an important role in the lives of coastal communities.

If you’re curious to learn more about the importance of coral reefs and how this partnership can contribute to their restoration, check out [**Dots.eco webpage**](https://dots.eco/impact-coral-reef-restoration/)! ☺️

title: DRAGON SOURCES
body:
![Dragon Sources](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/5TtS7XAv3Bf9aCSxxDen8X/dc5090ebb5f5fdf49129f5574c47ec64/003.png)

With the [**Breeding Update**](https://www.dragoncitygame.com/news/breeding-update) last December, we introduced a couple of improvements to Dragon City's general Breeding information, making it much easier for our Dragon Masters to understand the Breeding Sources of a dragon.

Given the success of such quality-of-life improvements, we've decided to take them even further this month with the **Dragon Sources Update**, available today on your [App Store](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/3213014026/WEB)!

But what is it all about? Let’s get into the details…

### **DRAGON SOURCES**

Up until now, it wasn’t so easy to understand where to obtain a dragon required to participate in a Quest battle or to complete a Collection.

With today’s update, we’ve made this much clearer: by simply tapping on a dragon’s portrait, you’ll be informed on a variety of sources from which the dragon is obtainable (i.e., through a specific Event Island, or the Missing Dragon Rescue, etc.), including if there isn’t any source currently available to obtain the specific dragon you’re looking for.

![Sources 1](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/46hK9VCkpdzpaMh0kKYV7k/3a7b7dbc4ba4319516dddbee7a47711a/Dragon_Sources_EX_1.png)

![Sources 2](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/3BstQeHFGuFpaWoUkgW2n2/681163dfeccd7ebf094a1b25f835f42a/Dragon_Sources_EX_2.png)

Moreover, with one quick tap on the Source button, you will be redirected to the respective feature to play and obtain your dragon.

As mentioned before, this improvement was partly introduced with last December's Breeding Update, and many more Source Buttons have now been added to make the information even more accessible!

### **SOULMATE FILTERS**

In addition to the above improvements, and based on our players’ suggestions, we’ve added a new filter to the Dragonbook Sources tab: **Soulmates**.

By tapping on this brand-new filter, you’ll quickly discover which dragons are breedable via Soulmate Pairings.

![Soulmate Filter](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/1VRD71Jso776qfKkEsLUlI/b7663ebd6d7fa4d4475d8c01a9419be2/Soulmates_Filter.png)

And as your feedback can really make a difference, don’t forget to leave your opinion on this update on our Official Social Media Channels or our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/dragoncity)! 😉

body:

The first-ever Heroic Evader is coming to Dragon City, Dragon Masters. Will you be able to get a glimpse of this elusive dragon?

His chaotic attacks are a Rhinodillo’s worst nightmare… A dream for any Dragon Master who intends to tame and use this Heroic dragon's elusive tactics!

The High Elusion Evader Dragon also brings a breeze of change to our Divine Pass Collection format. Its duration will be shortened to a **43-day** **cycle**, meaning there’ll be a special Divine Pass Season of 15 days, followed by a 28-day Divine Pass Season.

These changes will affect the [**Severed Souls Event**](https://www.dragoncitygame.com/it/news/severed-souls), whose third 28-day Divine Pass Season was removed, to welcome the new 43-day cycle. But don’t you worry Dragon Masters–we’ve extended the Severed Souls Collection **until March, 6th 2025**, as well as the availability of Extractor Insignias in-game. You’ll be able to find them in the upcoming Season of the Divine Pass “Elusive Illusion”, Event Islands, Quests, and Offers!

Now get ready to participate in the 43-day Elusive Illusion event, available **from January 23rd until March 6th, 2025,**  to earn amazing rewards, including the High Elusion Evader Dragon’s two new Skill Skins and Orbs to Empower him ➡️ [CLICK HERE!](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/3213014026/WEB )

---

### **ELUSIVE ILLUSION COLLECTION**

Collect **Evader Insignias** and complete milestones in the Elusive Illusion event. For the whole duration of the event, Evader Insignias can be found in the next Divine Pass Season, Event Islands, Quests for the Evader dragons, and Offers (both in-game and on our Official Webstore).

##### **REWARDS**

Rewards are waiting for you at each milestone of the Elusive Illusion Collection!

- **Milestone 1 “Collect Evader Insignias” ➡️** Complete it for a chance to earn Evader Insignias, Gems, Orbs of Evader dragons, Breeding Perks, and Food;
- **Milestone 2 “Hide behind the illusion” ➡️** Complete it for a chance to earn Orbs of the High Elusion Evader Dragon, and Orbs of the latest Heroic dragons in Dragon City, as well as Food, Tokens, Trading Essences, and Joker Orbs;
- **Milestone 3 “Evade your enemies” ➡️** Complete it for a chance to earn the High Elusion Evader Dragon and some of the most powerful dragons in Dragon City, as well as Joker Orbs and Gems;

Please notice that because of the changes applied to the duration of the Divine Pass cycle, we will give fewer Evader dragons Orbs inside their dragon Quests. This is because you’ll be given 2 Quests for each Evader dragon (Onrush Evader, Havoc Evader, and Hailing Evader) so you’ll still be able to obtain the same amount of Orbs as before…if not more 😉!

These Quests can be found inside the next Divine Pass Collection, starting around April.

**UPDATE**

Based on the feedback we've received regarding this change of the Evader dragon Quests, we've established that this isn't what you, Dragon Masters, want to see ingame, and therefore **we've reverted this change!** The Evader dragon Quests will give the same amount of Orbs per dragon and Quest as usual. This also means changes regarding the second Quest per dragon during the April Divine Pass Collection, but we'll share more details on that when it's time.

##### **SPECIAL DIVINE PASS: ELUSIVE ILLUSION**

_(January 23rd - February 6th)_

Play this special Season of the Divine Pass to obtain the first-ever Heroic Evader dragon: the High Elusion Evader Dragon.

Go Elite to get 300 of his Orbs, plus a special Lotus Skill Skin that boosts damage dealt by the dragon.

And that’s not all… Treat yourself to the Webstore-exclusive offer: the Elite Pass PLUS! By purchasing the Elite Pass PLUS, you will receive all the benefits of the Elite Pass, plus 200 extra Orbs of the High Elusion Evader Dragon and even more rewards!

##### **NEW SKILL SKINS**

Take your High Elusion Evader to the next level with two new Skill Skins!

This Skill Skin boosts damage for its Evasion Skill and Ice attack, reduces skill cooldown, and boosts its life points;

- Get the Elite Divine Pass to earn the **Lotus Skill Skin**:

This Skill Skin boosts damage for its Energy Overflow skill and Chaos attack, and boosts its damage stat.

title: BREEDING UPDATE
body:
![Breeding Update](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/jmUaMWN3sX8eqMlGLBEur/ec147ff91238e6980f6c20906f2f02c9/Breeding_Update.jpg)

What better way to welcome the holiday season and close the year than with some exciting news? A new update is on its way to Dragon City!

We’re introducing some important improvements to our Breeding system–let’s get into the details!

### **NEW: SOULMATE PAIRINGS**

Did you know that even dragons have a soulmate? ☺️

From now on, you can pair Soulmate dragons to obtain unique offspring that cannot be found via regular breeding–thanks to Soulmate pairings, **200+ more dragons are now breedable**!

When two Soulmate dragons are paired in the Breeding Cave, a **new Heart icon** with a **“Unique” banner** appears, informing you which exclusive dragon egg this pair is breeding for you.

![Soulmates Heart](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/7CO7xICWK1scKzAVz3oH0j/bc48b7affd2bab7ee75f7866ae61c59c/gr-heart-full-targeted-ribbon__1_.png)

Additionally, it shows other possible breeding results from this Soulmate pairing with information on their Rarity, and whether you already own them or not.

##### **LEVEL REQUIREMENTS**

Attention, Dragon Masters: Some Soulmate pairs must meet certain **level requirements** to breed their unique offspring (e.g. each parent should have reached at least level 30).

If that’s the case, the icon of the offspring egg in the “parents selection” screen will be grayed out and a “locked” badge will appear on the offspring box.

![Locked ](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/01aV27czNCT4kAzcXAEhFT/7c3f4e839be64e2c48f267c74a57e341/Property_1_Locked__6___1_.png)

### **BREEDING INFORMATION IMPROVEMENTS**

Additionally, we’ve made some important improvements to **general Breeding information**: Simply tap on a dragon’s portrait to learn about its sources (e.g. Shop, Breeding, Rescue, etc), and find a specific Breeding button for all breedable dragons.

If more than two obtention methods are available, we’ll show you the best two according to a system of priorities. This system will be further improved in the upcoming months!

---

Head to your App Store and update your Dragon City to test out the **new Breeding Update**, and help your favorite dragons find their Soulmate! ➡️ [**CLICK HERE**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/3213014026/WEB)

Breed more dragons than ever before by pairing specific parents to obtain the desired offspring, and let us know your thoughts on this update!
